dedupe_keys.name: us northeast distribution circuit geospatial preparation

description: The US Northeast electric-network team publishes Python scripts for processing utility circuit maps. The GitHub README describes cleaning, transformation and spatial analysis using GeoPandas, Pandas and NumPy, with directories for state circuits and derived metrics. Licence: MIT, read from the repository's package metadata on 2026-09-28; obtaining it is free of charge. The workflow can help convert utility hosting-capacity GIS into network inputs and tract summaries for resilience simulations, with model-pypsa a related network model at a different scale. Coverage follows the utility layers and northeastern states supplied as inputs. A caveat is that disconnected line work, duplicate segments and inconsistent voltage fields need explicit checks before graph analysis. The README and metadata were read, but the code was not run and the outputs were not compared with the separate Dataverse cleaned and result packages. Public source visibility does not settle redistribution rights.
